# AlphaCode

> Free MIT-licensed AI coding agent for your terminal. Built in Rust and developed by Ali Essam.

Version: v1.1.19 (pinned from https://github.com/dragonked2/alphacode/releases/latest; refreshed during scheduled builds)
Source: https://github.com/dragonked2/alphacode
Website: https://alphacli.github.io/

- [Installation](https://alphacli.github.io/install/): exact platform commands, verification and troubleshooting
- [Benchmarks](https://alphacli.github.io/benchmarks/): historical memory snapshots and methodology
- [Documentation](https://alphacli.github.io/docs/): workflows, commands, providers
- [MCP](https://alphacli.github.io/mcp/): extension and security overview
- [About](https://alphacli.github.io/about/): project and author
- [Official README](https://github.com/dragonked2/alphacode#readme): authoritative for version-specific CLI behavior

AlphaCode has a free built-in AI provider. Paid third-party providers are optional. The website's terminal UI is an illustration, not proof that a code modification occurred.
